## Play: Crash the Project

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Crash the Project (10 to 15 min)" icon="false"}
Every day a project runs costs money. Find the [critical path]{.term}, then pay to shorten the right activities. Shorten an activity that has [slack]{.term} and you waste the money. Shorten the cheapest critical one and you save. Afterwards, see the whole [time-cost trade-off]{.term} and the schedule with the lowest total cost. The game practices [crashing]{.term} a project against its [indirect cost]{.term}.

{{< game crash-the-project title="Crash the Project" height="900" >}}
:::
